body.message:
Thank you very much for providing the signed agreement and for clarifying the cancellation policy. We now understand and accept that the unused nights following our early departure are non-refundable.

I would, however, like to clarify a few points regarding the security deposit and the final inspection.

Having reviewed the agreement again, I noted the following under the refundable security deposit section:

“Subject to final inspection and deductions for damages, missing items, or extra cleaning.”

Could you please clarify what is meant by “extra cleaning” and what circumstances would result in a deduction?

During our stay, we were unfortunately not provided with a working vacuum cleaner, and we did not have the appropriate cleaning equipment to properly clean the apartment to a high standard before check-out. We will still do our best to leave the unit in a clean and tidy condition.

I would also like to note that when we checked into the apartment, it was not cleaned to a particularly high standard. There were areas that had clearly not been cleaned properly, and there were also pre-existing maintenance issues, including the floorboard bridge not being properly secured. We want to ensure that these existing issues are recorded so that we are not held responsible for them during the final inspection.

Could you please confirm that only any damage or cleaning requirements caused during our tenancy will be considered, and that we will not be held liable for any pre-existing issues?

Thank you, and we look forward to your confirmation.

Kind regards,
